comment: Single source of truth for the private-source provenance screen. The spawned-cell converter (scripts/spawned_cells_to_ts.py) REFUSES agent-authored cell text matching this pattern and WITHHOLDS matching reviewer-authored preSubmitReview text behind the marker; site/src/__tests__/forecast-catalog.test.ts enforces the same pattern over the entire public catalog payload as the fail-closed backstop. Edit the pattern only with review; the canary test pins the required tokens.
pattern: granola|\btranscripts?\b|meeting notes?|meeting with max|pasted-text|\.codex/attachments|codex attachments|private meeting|call notes?|email thread|chat transcript
